mechanics.name: Empower Jace
mechanics.summary: Add the stated loyalty to a Jace planeswalker token, creating one first if needed. Its abilities spend one loyalty to surveil or three to draw; nontoken Jaces cannot receive empower counters.

mechanics.name: Heartwood tokens
mechanics.summary: Heartwood is a red and green artifact token that taps for red or green mana without being sacrificed. These reusable mana sources also support artifact payoffs.

mechanics.name: Prepare
mechanics.summary: A prepared permanent lets you cast its associated spell copy from exile and pay its cost, then becomes unprepared. Losing the permanent loses that copy. The underlying card remains a creature card in every zone.

mechanics.name: Flashback
mechanics.summary: Pay a spell's flashback cost to cast it from the graveyard, following normal timing. It is exiled afterward, even if countered; budget for any additional discard cost.

mechanics.name: Threshold and graveyard resources
mechanics.summary: Threshold needs seven cards in your graveyard. Surveil and self-mill build that count; flashback and graveyard exile abilities reduce it. Jace tokens and prepared spell copies cannot supply lasting cards there.

mechanics.name: Loyalty abilities and Ways
mechanics.summary: Ways give planeswalkers new abilities or reward their activations. Each planeswalker normally activates just one loyalty ability on your turn at sorcery speed, regardless of how many abilities it has gained.

archetypes.name: Fatehold surveil aggro
archetypes.playstyle: Develop evasive threats, then scry or surveil before combat to enable attacks and team pumps. Preserve a Jace token for repeatable selection; prepared Peer Review spells add both a Cadet and another surveil trigger.

archetypes.name: Liliana's attrition
archetypes.playstyle: Trade expendable creatures, then reuse their entry and death effects. Sacrifice outlets convert small bodies into removal or larger threats; recursion keeps the engine supplied while death triggers build life and loyalty.

archetypes.name: Ajani's Army counters
archetypes.playstyle: Build a broad board with Cadet makers and distribute counters onto attackers. Counters enable haste, flying and cheaper equipment moves; team pumps turn multiple bodies into a finishing attack.

archetypes.name: Vigorbloom life gain and counters
archetypes.playstyle: Combine frequent life gain with creatures that grow or draw from it. Prepared Seed Suture spells supply both life and counters; vigilance lets the enlarged board attack while protecting Jace.

archetypes.name: Theorix graveyard math
archetypes.playstyle: Use self-mill, surveil and cheap interaction to reach seven graveyard cards. Threshold improves your threats, while flashback and reanimation convert the stocked graveyard into resources. Recount before spending graveyard cards.

archetypes.name: Chandra's prowess
archetypes.playstyle: Deploy spell payoffs before chaining cheap noncreature spells. Prepare and flashback provide additional casts for prowess and Thopters; bounce and burn clear attacks while spell discounts help maintain momentum.

archetypes.name: Jace's mastery
archetypes.playstyle: Protect Jace while repeated empower effects grow creatures and fund loyalty abilities. Activate before combat for Kiora's evasion; choose between immediate cards and saving loyalty for larger creature tokens.

archetypes.name: Stingerquill face burn
archetypes.playstyle: Deal noncombat damage to the opponent to unlock recursion, flying and haste. Prepared Vicious Verse spells make repeatable enablers; retain enough removal to keep attacking while damage triggers accumulate.

archetypes.name: Garruk's bestiary
archetypes.playstyle: Build around creatures with useful entry effects, then recur them after trades. Mill and basic landcycling supply graveyard targets and support Hapatra; large bodies let green's damage spells answer threats.

archetypes.name: Konstrari Heartwood ramp
archetypes.playstyle: Invest early in Heartwood and other mana sources, then cast large creatures or spend mana on repeatable abilities. Artifact payoffs reward the same tokens that accelerate your curve; keep enough early blockers.

combos.note: If Fateseer hasn't triggered this turn, Peer Review's surveil pumps its newly created Cadet too. Cast it before combat.
Oculus supplies Jace loyalty for surveil activations. Leave two mana to turn each Proft trigger into a counter and a card.
Sacrifice Ghoul to grow Edgar and gain life, then pay to return and recast Ghoul for another exchange.
After Rat takes a card from the opponent's hand, sacrifice it to Winter to make that opponent sacrifice a creature too.
Heartstring and its Cadet each trigger Mabel, giving two counters across creatures that entered this turn.
Put counters on the intended carrier before equipping; each counter removes one generic mana from Blades' equip cost.
Creature entries gain life and enable one Bloombrute draw per turn. Flash creatures can repeat this on the opponent's turn.
Restore recovers a permanent and gains life, adding two counters to Titanbones. One life-gain event triggers it once, regardless of amount.
Their prepared Omit Variables spells mill six cards toward threshold. The spell copies themselves do not remain in the graveyard.
Discard Proft to shrink a creature, then reanimate its 5/5 menace body. Its threshold casting restriction does not prevent reanimation.
Casting Twinned Vision and later its flashback creates two separate hasty Thopters. Budget for flashback's additional discard cost.
Casting prepared Improvised Act creates a Thopter and triggers prowess. A prepare copy is cast; a spell copied directly on the stack is not.
Target Tethermage to add two counters in total: one from Resistance and one from its trigger for the batch of loyalty counters.
A loyalty activation grants another land play, which can trigger Avatar to empower Jace. Adding loyalty does not permit a second activation.
Vicious Verse's opponent damage unlocks Repriser's recursion. The returned creature has a finality counter and is exiled if it later dies.
Cast Heckler's prepared Vicious Verse before combat to give Wordsmith flying and haste for that turn.
Basic landcycling puts Apex's mana value six in your graveyard, letting Hapatra apply at least six -1/-1 counters when it enters.
Witchstalker mills reanimation targets while recovering a land. Rewrite can return Witchstalker to repeat that entry effect and also empower Jace.
While Visitor is out, Soul Tether produces a 5/5 flying Dragon instead of Heartwood. That token no longer supplies mana.
Crafter's restricted mana can pay for Soul Tether cast from exile, accelerating a reusable Heartwood mana source.

haymakers.name: Uldaros Theorix
haymakers.reason: A 5/5 flyer plus up to six mana of graveyard spell copies creates an immediate board and card advantage swing.

haymakers.name: Ajani Unrelenting
haymakers.reason: Each loyalty activation creates a creature; the damage sweep preserves your tokens and can reverse the board.

haymakers.name: The Theorist, Jace Beleren
haymakers.reason: Extra cards each opposing draw step, blockers, and bounce let this planeswalker take over a long game.

haymakers.name: Draconic Visitor
haymakers.reason: Artifact token makers become 5/5 flying Dragon makers; requires reliable token production.

haymakers.name: Kindred Judgment
haymakers.reason: Can preserve your chosen creature type while clearing the rest; requires a favorable creature-type distribution.
